scope: #021/B7 public same-shot diagnostic, not the original T5 all-challenge benchmark

experiment.selection: First provider round count greater than the prior 8-round study and present in both the published training and the published testing schedule. Retain all eight preparations and all test rows; no further filtering.

decoder.joint_fit: Two coordinate sweeps in log-odds with the fixed steps; optimize joint observed class-0/1/2 training likelihood with the terminal data vector. Fit each injection arm on provider train only; retain parameters unchanged across its matched policies.
decoder.comparison: Exact causal filter on data flips, accumulating ancilla parity, and previous two flags. Ternary preserves the hard observation and conditions on the observed class; matched hard comparator sums over admissible flags with the same fit. Also score a separately binary-trained reference and a placebo obtained by shifting flags across shots within the same preparation, round, readout line and raw hard-one slots. Only terminal adjacent parities reach test decoding.

diagnostic_gate: Report exact paired discordant counts and one-sided binomial comparisons versus both hard policies in each injection cell. Improvement in a cell is declared only if both p-values are at most 0.0125 (Bonferroni for four paired comparisons) and aligned predictions beat the placebo in count. No pooling or tuning on any selected test file.
claim_boundary: Class 2 is an assigned measurement, not latent leakage truth. A gain applies to this public code, operating condition and held-out set. Original T5 calibration/denominator, B7 credit, and hardware execution by us remain unproved.
